title: Root tests/ import helpers with `from conftest import ...`: the gatekeeper no longer makes tests/ a package under them
source: example 09 live run 11-15 (docs/handoff/ex09-1115-dag-target-file-diagnosis.md section 1): QA attempts 1 and 3 failed collection, PY.TEST_SETUP_ERROR tests.test_main (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'conftest'), because the platform added tests/__init__.py under a test module that imports its sibling conftest.py at top level
mechanism: CONFTEST-TOP-LEVEL-IMPORT: the add-only package scaffolding (gatekeeper verifier.purge_shadowed_package_files) skips exactly a directory whose own files import the top-level module `conftest` next to its conftest.py (AST facts; no relative import, nothing imports the directory as a package). The sandbox rule is pytest's own import rule (default prepend mode), pinned by tests/test_conftest_top_level_import.py with real pytest collections
